stateDetail: Gaia DR4 is expected on 2026-12-02; the Gaia archive re-opens with it at 12:00 CET (11:00 UTC).

policy.hostLink: A known host (NASA Exoplanet Archive PSCompPars, by its Gaia DR3 source_id) is linked to every DR4 source that Gaia's dr3_neighbourhood table lists as its neighbour, with Gaia's probable_match flag; DR4 sources within the radius of the host's catalogue position are linked by position. An equal source_id number is never taken as identity.
policy.positionEpochs: DR4 positions are at epoch J2017.5; host positions are the catalogue's J2000 values, so separations are context for moving stars.

claimBoundary: Gaia DR4 values are shown as the Gaia collaboration published them, under Gaia's column names. A Gaia exoplanet candidate or planetary-transit candidate is a candidate, not a confirmed planet. Links to known planet hosts come from Gaia's dr3_neighbourhood table or from position; they are context, every matching host is listed and none is chosen. Values marked "calculated" are unit conversions made by WorldsIndex.
